name: Harness and cabinet wiring
description: Wires and terminals from the Electrical add-on's schematic: an id, colour, gauge, type and end treatment for every wire, a from-to list, a wire list with cut lengths, connector tables, a harness drawing with branch points and lengths, a control-cabinet layout (back panel, DIN rails, ducts, devices on the rails) and a bill of materials.
author: CadCraft
